comparisons.reason: Feature 0 flags only explicit assertions of absolute certainty/incontrovertibility about the OP's own view (ordinary confident opinion is 0). Feature 1 flags any unqualified absolute declarative claim (all/always/never/obviously, or flat assertions), which is much broader and not about certainty of the view. Many posts would be 0 on feature 0 and 1 on feature 1.
